privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: {app} is a service for owners of Instagram Business or Creator accounts: creating content with AI assistance, scheduling and publishing posts to Instagram and Threads, and replying to DMs and comments, through Meta’s official API. Users sign up with an email and password or with a Google account, then connect one Instagram account they own.
This policy explains what data we process, what for, who we share it with, and how you control it. It is part of the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms>. Questions can be sent to <mail>{email}</mail>.

sections.title: Data we process
blocks: User account: email address and password. The password is stored as a hash by the sign-in system, never in its original form. If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account’s name and email address.
Instagram and Threads accounts: account ID, username, account type, granted permissions, token expiry and access token. Tokens are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM).

Instagram profile on first connection: to fill in the brand kit, {app} reads the name, bio, profile picture and the captions of up to 12 recent posts of the connected account. The profile picture is saved as the brand logo and the images of the 3 most recent posts are copied as design references. All of it can be changed or deleted on the Brand page.
User content: photos, captions, slides and post schedules, content ideas, uploaded assets, and the IDs and links of published posts, along with records of failed publishing.

Post statistics: for the Analytics page, {app} reads the connected account’s posts from the last 90 days (ID, type, caption, link, thumbnail, publish time) with their insights: views, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves and total interactions. Only the latest numbers are kept; posts deleted from Instagram or Threads are removed at the next sync.

Direct messages: if you send a DM to an Instagram account connected to {app}, Meta forwards to this service your Instagram ID specific to that account, your username, name and profile picture link, the message ID, the text of the message and its time. The profile picture link is refreshed at most every 3 days and is only used to show an avatar in the inbox. Attachments such as photos and videos are not stored. The account owner’s messages in that conversation, whether sent through {app} or directly from the Instagram app, are stored too so the conversation can be read in full, along with when the owner last opened it. DMs are not stored while the account owner’s subscription is inactive.

Comments and replies: if you comment on an Instagram post or reply to a Threads post of an account connected to {app}, this service stores the comment ID, post ID, your ID and username, the comment text, its time, the comment it replies to, and whether it is hidden. Comments are received from Meta when written and pulled again from posts of the last 30 days when the owner opens the Replies page, so the owner can read, reply to, hide or delete them. Comments deleted on the platform are removed at the next pull.

Brand references and website Assets: the content of up to 11 pages of the brand’s website, images the user chooses to import into Assets, and public posts of other Instagram business or creator accounts chosen as design references, with the account name and link. The name, bio and follower count of those other accounts are only shown while searching and are not stored.

Conversations with Mimo: your messages and the answers of the AI assistant Mimo, and images you attach. The content of PDF files is only read at that moment and not stored; the history shows only the file name.
AI request history: what was sent to the AI and the result, the model, status, duration and credits used. Kept to count quotas and trace problems.
Payments: the buyer’s name and WhatsApp number, amount, status, Mayar payment link, coupon used, and subscription period.

Cookies: a sign-in session cookie so you stay signed in and a `locale` preference cookie to remember your chosen language (ID/EN). {app} does not use third-party advertising, tracking or analytics cookies.

sections.title: What the data is used for
blocks: Data is only used to run features for the user who owns it: drafting content, publishing scheduled posts, showing and replying to DMs and comments, notifying the owner of new messages or comments, showing post performance, processing payments, and customer support.
One user’s data cannot be seen by other users. Every DM and comment reply is sent by the account owner. {app} does not send bulk or unsolicited messages.

sections.title: Who the data is shared with
blocks: Meta (Instagram and Threads): to publish posts, fetch profiles and post statistics, read comments, send DM and comment replies, and hide or delete comments on the account owner’s instruction.
Mayar: name, email, WhatsApp number and invoice amount, to process subscription payments. Your card or bank details are processed by Mayar and never reach {app}.

AI providers through 9Router: topics, captions, brand information, brand website content, the user’s Instagram username, name, bio and captions, reference images, Mimo messages and their attachments, and product or website images chosen for the catalog or content are sent to create drafts. The text of DMs and comments (up to the last 10 messages, plus the post caption for comments) is sent only when the account owner presses an AI button to draft a reply, without the sender’s ID or profile picture.
Apify: the usernames or keywords you search for in Mimo’s competitor research, to read matching public Instagram profiles.
Supabase: the database, sign-in and file storage provider where all {app} data is stored.
Data is not sold and is not used for advertising.

sections.title: Storage and security
blocks: The dashboard can only be opened after signing in, every request only reads data belonging to the signed-in user, the database is not publicly accessible, and files are only opened through signed links that expire within 1 hour.

{app} admins can see users’ email, sign-up and last sign-in dates, the connected Instagram username, subscription status, payment history, and the number and status of AI requests (without their content), for customer support and billing. Admins can reset passwords, suspend or delete accounts, and every such action is logged.

sections.title: How long data is kept
blocks: Access tokens are deleted when you disconnect in Settings, and also when the subscription is inactive.
Other data is kept while your account is active.

When you delete your account, the account is closed and its data archived: it can no longer be opened from the app and is not used for any feature. The archive is deleted permanently at your request. Details are in <deletion>Data Deletion</deletion>.
Transaction records are kept for 10 years as required by tax law. Records of admin actions, including the email of the affected account, are kept as an audit trail.

sections.title: Your rights
blocks: Under Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to request a copy of your data, correct inaccurate data, withdraw consent, and request that your data be deleted. Send your request to <mail>{email}</mail> from your account’s email address. We reply within 3×24 hours and complete it within 30 days at the latest.

sections.title: Terms of service
blocks: The terms of use, pricing and subscriptions are in the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms>. Refund conditions are in the <refund>Refund Policy</refund>.

sections.title: Data deletion
blocks: You can delete your account at any time from <settings>Settings</settings>, and you can also ask by email for your data to be deleted permanently. Senders of DMs and comments can request deletion of their data too. All the ways to do so are on the <deletion>Data Deletion</deletion> page.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
blocks: Changes are announced by updating this page and the date above. For important changes, we also notify you by email or in the dashboard.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
intro: Welcome to {app}. By creating an account or using the {app} service (the “Service”), you agree to these Terms & Conditions (the “Terms”). Use of the Service is also subject to the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and the <refund>Refund Policy</refund>. Please read all three before using the Service.

sections.title: About the Service
blocks: {app} helps businesses and creators create and manage social media content with AI assistance. Current features include:
An AI creator for carousel content, captions and images, following your brand kit.
A scheduler that publishes posts to the Instagram (feed and Story) and Threads accounts you connect.
An inbox to read and reply to DMs and comments.
Analytics for the post metrics available through the platforms’ official APIs.
Mimo, an AI assistant for content ideas, research and planning.
We may add, change or remove features. Important changes are announced in advance.

{app} is a tool. We do not guarantee reach, engagement, follower counts, sales or any particular business result. Content performance on social platforms depends on platform algorithms, content quality and other factors outside our control.

sections.title: User accounts
blocks: You must be at least 18 years old or otherwise legally competent.
You are responsible for keeping your sign-in confidential and for all activity on your account. Tell us right away if you suspect unauthorised access.
Provide accurate information when signing up and when paying.
Only connect Instagram and Threads accounts you own or are entitled to manage. You are responsible for the content and replies that are published.
One {app} account per person or business. Do not share your sign-in with others.

sections.title: Your content and AI output
blocks: Ownership: content you upload or create with {app} remains yours (“Your Content”).

Limited licence to {app}: you allow us to store, process and transmit Your Content as far as needed to run the Service, including passing it to social platforms on your instruction and to AI providers to create drafts.

AI output: you may use AI output for commercial purposes after you have reviewed, edited and approved it. You are responsible for what you publish, including product claims, sector advertising rules (for example BPOM for cosmetics, food and medicine, or OJK for financial products), and intellectual property rights in other parties’ brands, logos and images.
We do not guarantee that AI output is always accurate, original or free of third-party rights. Always check before publishing.

sections.title: Prohibited use
blocks: You may not use {app} to:
Break Indonesian law or any law that applies to you.
Create or spread content that promotes violence, hate speech, harassment or discrimination.
Spread hoaxes, scams or fraudulent investment schemes.
Infringe other parties’ intellectual property, privacy or publicity rights.
Violate the Meta Platform Terms, the Instagram and Threads Terms of Use, or the Instagram Community Guidelines. Spam, bulk messages and unsolicited messages are prohibited.
Circumvent quotas or credits, abuse the Service through automation, or interfere with the Service’s security.
Violations may lead to the account being suspended or closed and, for serious violations, reported to the authorities.

sections.title: Subscriptions, credits and payment
blocks: New accounts can try {app} for free with one-time trial credits and a few Mimo messages, without a card. After that, paid features require a subscription on the following terms:
A subscription can be paid in advance for several months at once, at the discount shown at checkout.
Payments are in Rupiah through Mayar. Access starts once the payment is confirmed and lasts until the end of the paid period.
Prices may change. Changes do not affect periods already paid, because the purchase terms are saved at checkout.
Refunds are governed by the <refund>Refund Policy</refund>, which is part of these Terms.

sections.title: Termination
blocks: By you: you can delete your account at any time from Settings. The account is closed and its data archived as described in Data Deletion. A running subscription ends too.

By us: we may suspend or close accounts that violate these Terms, endanger the Service or other users, or on the order of a lawful authority. For minor violations, we notify you and give you a chance to fix them first.

sections.title: Disclaimer
blocks: The Service is provided “as is” and “as available”. The Service depends on third-party APIs such as Meta’s, so we do not guarantee that it is always available without interruption or free of errors.
This disclaimer does not limit consumer rights protected by Law Number 8 of 1999 on Consumer Protection and Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
blocks: To the extent permitted by law, {app}’s total liability for any claim related to the Service is limited to the total fees you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. {app} is not liable for indirect losses, such as lost profits or business opportunities.
This limitation does not apply to losses caused by {app}’s gross negligence or wilful misconduct, or by a breach of personal data protection obligations.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
blocks: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Disputes are first settled amicably within 30 days of written notice. If that fails, disputes are settled at the South Jakarta District Court (Pengadilan Negeri Jakarta Selatan).

sections.title: Changes to the Terms
blocks: We may change these Terms. For important changes, we notify you by email or in the dashboard at least 14 days before they take effect. If you do not agree, you can stop using the Service and delete your account.

refund.title: Refund Policy
intro: This policy applies to all {app} subscription payments (the Pro and Max plans, monthly or paid in advance for several months) and is part of the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms>.

sections.title: Try it free first
blocks: Every new account gets free trial credits without a card, enough to create your first content and try Mimo. We recommend using them before you pay, so you know whether {app} suits your business.

sections.title: First-purchase guarantee: 7 days
blocks: If {app} turns out not to be a fit, request a refund within 7 days of your first payment. We refund the full amount paid, as long as during that period:
you used no more than 10% of the first month’s AI credits, and
no post was published or scheduled through {app}.
Beyond that, the current month counts as used. This guarantee applies once per user. Once the money is returned, paid access ends.

sections.title: 3, 6 or 12-month plans
blocks: Unused full months are refunded pro rata, counted from the date we receive your request. The current month is not refunded.
The amount is based on the monthly price you actually paid: the total payment after the duration discount and any coupon, divided by the number of months.

sections.title: No automatic billing
blocks: {app} never charges you automatically. A new period only starts if you pay for it yourself, so no renewal is ever charged without your knowledge.

sections.title: Payment errors and service outages
blocks: Charged twice for the same order: we refund the extra payment in full.
Paid but the plan did not activate because of an error on our side: we activate the plan, or refund you in full if you prefer.
The Service could not be used because of a fault on {app}’s side for more than 3 days in a row: we make up the lost days with an extended active period, or refund them pro rata.
A payment that arrives after the account was deleted, for example from an old payment link: we refund it in full.

sections.title: How to request
blocks: Email <refundMail>{email}</refundMail> from your account’s email address with the subject “Permintaan Refund”. Include the payment number from your Mayar receipt and a short reason. We reply within 2 business days.
If you have already deleted your account, send it from the same email address as that account. Its payment records are still kept in the archive.

sections.title: Process and timing
blocks: Refunds are made through Mayar to the original payment method within 7 business days of approval. Your bank or e-wallet provider may need a few more days to show it. If the original method does not support refunds, the money is transferred to a bank account in the buyer’s name.
Once a refund is approved, paid access for the refunded period ends, along with that period’s AI credits.

sections.title: What is not refunded
blocks: The current month, outside the first-purchase guarantee.
AI credits already used.
Free periods or extra credits given without payment, including through a 100% coupon.
Accounts suspended or closed for violating the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms>.

deletion.title: Data Deletion
intro: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data from {app} at any time, under Law Number 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection. This page explains what happens when you delete your account and how to request permanent deletion.

sections.title: Delete your account from the dashboard

ol: Open Settings, then scroll to the Delete account section at the very bottom.
Click Delete account, type your account’s email address, then confirm.

blocks: The account is closed right away and you are signed out of every session. At the same time:
Instagram, Facebook and Threads are disconnected and their access tokens deleted.
Scheduled posts go back to drafts and will not be published. AI content generation still in progress is stopped.
Unpaid invoices are closed. A running subscription ends too.

Your email and Google sign-in are released from the old account. If you later sign in again with the same email or Google account, you get a new, empty account. Nothing from the old account comes back.

sections.title: Archived data
blocks: Deleting your account from the dashboard does not immediately erase its content. The following data is kept as an archive:
Brand kit, design references and assets with their files.
Posts, drafts, content ideas and publishing history.
Stored DMs, comments and replies.
Conversations with Mimo and AI request history.
Payment history and account records (email, Instagram and Threads usernames, deletion date).

The archive cannot be opened from the app, is not used for any feature, and is not sent to AI providers. It is only used to process refunds, answer payment disputes, meet legal obligations, or carry out your requests. If you want the archive deleted too, request permanent deletion.

sections.title: Request permanent deletion
blocks: Email <deleteMail>{email}</deleteMail> from your account’s email address, before or after deleting the account, with the subject “Permintaan Penghapusan Data”. Include:
your account’s email address, and
the Instagram username that was connected (optional, speeds up verification).

We confirm receipt within 3×24 hours and complete the deletion within 30 days at the latest. The account, its content and all its files are deleted permanently, except the data listed under “What we still keep” below. When it is done, you get a confirmation by email.

sections.title: Senders of DMs and comments
blocks: If you have sent a DM or commented on an account managed with {app} and want that data deleted, email <deleteMail>{email}</deleteMail> with the subject “Permintaan Penghapusan Data” and include your Instagram or Threads username. Your conversations, messages and comments are deleted within 30 days of receiving the email. You can also request a copy of your data through the same email.

sections.title: What we still keep
blocks: After permanent deletion, some data is still kept because of legal obligations or legitimate purposes:
Transaction records: amount, date and payer identity are kept for 10 years as required by tax law.
Records of admin actions: including the email of the affected account, as an audit trail.
Records of deletion requests: email, request date and completion date, to prove the request was carried out.
Backups: encrypted database backups at our infrastructure provider (Supabase) expire on their own with the backup cycle, within 30 days at most.

sections.title: Revoke access without deleting your account
blocks: You can revoke {app}’s access to your social accounts without deleting your {app} account: disconnect in <settings>Settings</settings>, then remove {app} in Instagram (Settings and activity → Website permissions → Apps and websites). The account’s data stays and becomes visible again if the same account is connected again.

sections.title: Questions?
blocks: Contact us at <mail>{email}</mail> or <phoneLink>{phone}</phoneLink> if you have questions or need help with a deletion request.
